title: LiftGCN: Efficient Energy-Preserving Graph Learning via Joukowski Spectral Lifting for Finite Element Stress Prediction
abstract: arXiv:2609.14977v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Finite element stress fields often exhibit strong local non-smoothness, where stress concentrations near holes, notches, and loading regions induce sharp spatial gradients and high-frequency graph components. Although graph neural networks naturally operate on irregular finite element meshes, conventional message passing is inherently smoothing and progressively attenuates such high-frequency information. Unitary propagation alleviates this problem by preserving spectral magnitudes, but typically relies on matrix functions and high-order approximations with $O(Ked)$ propagation complexity. We propose LiftGCN, an efficient spectrally stable graph network based on Joukowski spectral lifting. LiftGCN maps the real spectrum of a normalized graph operator onto the unit circle through the Joukowski relation and realizes the resulting spectral transformation as a simple second-order recurrence, avoiding matrix exponentials, eigendecomposition

translated_title: LiftGCN：基于茹科夫斯基谱提升的高效保能图学习方法用于有限元应力预测
translated_abstract: 有限元应力场通常表现出强烈的局部非光滑性，其中孔洞、缺口和加载区域附近的应力集中会引起尖锐的空间梯度和高频图分量。尽管图神经网络天然适用于不规则有限元网格，但传统的消息传递机制本质上是平滑的，会逐渐衰减此类高频信息。酉传播通过保持谱幅度缓解了这一问题，但通常依赖于矩阵函数和高阶近似，传播复杂度达 $O(Ked)$。我们提出了 LiftGCN，一种基于茹科夫斯基谱提升的高效谱稳定图网络。LiftGCN 通过茹科夫斯基关系将归一化图算子的实谱映射到单位圆上，并将所得的谱变换实现为简单的二阶递推，从而避免了矩阵指数、特征分解等高成本运算。
tldr: LiftGCN 利用茹科夫斯基谱提升将图算子实谱映射到单位圆并以简单的二阶递推实现谱变换，在避免矩阵指数和特征分解等高成本运算的同时保持高频信息，实现了面向有限元应力预测的高效保能图学习。
en_tdlr: LiftGCN employs Joukowski spectral lifting to map the real spectrum of graph operators onto the unit circle via a simple second-order recurrence, achieving efficient energy-preserving graph learning for finite element stress prediction while avoiding costly matrix exponentials and eigendecomposition.
